proposal_title: Hierarchical Two-Tier GenerationJob Lifecycle State Machine & Stage Mapping
domain_specific_rationale: As the primary guardian of distributed reliability and state integrity, R02 strongly endorses the formal two-tier state machine architecture. Confining PostgreSQL database status to 7 coarse-grained, transactional states (QUEUED, RESERVED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, RECONCILED) eliminates high-frequency DB lock contention and write amplification. Meanwhile, delegating the 11+ fine-grained execution stages (e.g. WAITING_FOR_ASSETS, PROMPT_READY, BUDGET_RESERVED, SUBMITTING, SUBMITTED, GENERATING, DOWNLOADING, DOWNLOADED, QC_RUNNING) to workflow telemetry and event streams provides fine-grained observability without destabilizing transactional invariants. The Parent-to-Child Mapping Matrix ensures that crash recovery and lease timeouts can deterministically assess job health and prevent invalid lifecycle jumps.
capability_impact: Directly preserves and reinforces CAP-01 (Canonical Core State) and CAP-04 (Workflow Engine Orchestration), providing clear fault isolation and deterministic lease recovery semantics.
residual_risk: Asynchronous race condition if a crashed worker recovers just as the R02 Reconciliation Worker marks a job RECONCILED. Mitigated by strict atomic CAS (compare-and-swap) updates on lease_token and lease_expires_at in PostgreSQL.
